name: Threshold Guardian (Gatekeeper / Examiner)
motive: To make sure nothing crosses that has not earned the right to.
dread: A breach: letting through the one thing that ends the enterprise.
shadow: The Corrupted Bureaucrat: smallness compensated by power. It invents obstacles to feel large, and sells passage to whoever flatters it.
anchors: St. Peter at the gates, Matthew 16
example: Halt. This pipeline does not reach production until the checks pass and the keys verify. Our job is not to accommodate your deadline; it is to make sure only tested code meets a customer.
